item.title: Anjali Arora's Kanpur Show Cut Short After Row Over 'Kacha Badam' Song, Organisers Threaten Legal Action
item.description: Influencer Anjali Arora reportedly left a Kanpur dandiya event after about 15 minutes when the DJ played her viral 'Kacha Badam' track, and the event's organiser has accused her of staging a publicity stunt and threatened legal action.

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Nakul Dhull's Eviction Confirmed On Screen After Fight With Gullu
item.description: Bigg Boss has shown on air that wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull was evicted for his physical fight with Gullu, resolving days of rumour, though whether he gets a re-entry remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Rise and Fall 2: Shehzad Poonawalla's Ultimate Ruler Reign Ends as Sara Gurpal Clashes With Gautam Gulati
item.description: Shehzad Poonawalla's run as Ultimate Ruler on Rise and Fall 2 came to an end this week, and the same stretch of episodes saw Sara Gurpal and Gautam Gulati clash over a dining-table outburst that Gurpal said stirred memories of an abusive relationship.
